subject.title: fix(security): narrow sandbox parent to exact active session workspace to prevent cross-agent media read (#107972)

question: Should control-ui, deliver, send, chat-finalization, and plugin-SDK agent-scoped paths be categorically unable to read sandbox workspaces unless they carry an authoritative active sandbox root?
rationale: The code can enforce either contract, but repository history and tests do not conclusively establish whether every caller without sandbox context must fail closed or whether some callers need authoritative sandbox context threaded into them.

options.title: Confirm fail-closed contract
options.body: Keep the current patch shape and explicitly confirm that only message-action paths with an authoritative active sandbox root may authorize sandbox media.

options.title: Thread additional sandbox context
options.body: Identify legitimate non-message sandbox-media flows and pass their authoritative active sandbox root before removing the shared parent for those callers.

recommendation.title: Confirm fail-closed contract
recommendation.body: Keep the current patch shape and explicitly confirm that only message-action paths with an authoritative active sandbox root may authorize sandbox media.

likelyOwner.reason: They designed and merged the current active-agent media-root boundary that this decision refines.
